retrieval_settings.hit_rule: A metric-eligible question hits at k when either relevant parent is inside the top k parents.

questions.question: ሰንበትን የማክበር ትእዛዝ መቼ ተሰጠ?
questions.expected_concept: The command to keep the Sabbath was given at the end of creation, before the Ten Commandments were written as law. God himself rested as the pattern. The book says Israel already knew and kept the Sabbath before that written law.

questions.question: አባትና እናትን ስለማክበር ትእዛዙ ምን ይላል?
questions.expected_concept: Honor father and mother and the associated promise.

questions.question: “አትግደል” የሚለው ትእዛዝ ምን ያስተምራል?
questions.expected_concept: «አትግደል» is the book's fifth commandment. The passage says some people think it concerns only criminals and murderers. It asks whether God forbade every killing or whether some killing was permitted, and it records killing that the old law required. That old-law killing is not treated as breaking the command. Christ quotes the command and teaches that anger and insult against a brother are also liable to judgment.

questions.question: በባልንጀራ ላይ ሐሰት ምስክር ስለመሆን ትእዛዙ ምን ይላል?
ሰው ገንዘብንና እግዚአብሔርን በአንድ ጊዜ ለምን ማገልገል አይችልም?
questions.expected_concept: Money as an idol competing with worship of God.

questions.question: የዕረፍት ቀን ለሰው የተሰጠ ስጦታ እንጂ ሸክም አለመሆኑ እንዴት ይገለጻል?
questions.expected_concept: The Sabbath as a gracious gift for human rest.

questions.question: አንድን ሰው ከእግዚአብሔር ማራቅ ነፍሱን ከመግደል ጋር የሚመሳሰለው ለምንድን ነው?
questions.expected_concept: Causing a soul to leave the worship of God and remain in sinful deeds is killing that soul. A soul subjected to sin is dead. Leading people away from true faith is worse than bodily killing, because a person dead in the body may still be saved, while a person dead in the soul faces eternal suffering.

questions.question: ወላጆች የልጆቻቸውን መንፈሳዊ ሕይወት ለማሳደግ ምን ኃላፊነት አለባቸው?
questions.expected_concept: Parents are responsible to teach their children and to raise them in the fear of God, leading their spiritual life rather than only their social life. The book says that failing to lead that spiritual life kills them in the soul, and that parents who constantly quarrel at home have killed the hope of their children's spiritual life.

questions.question: የተመኙትን ነገር ማግኘት ምኞትን ከማጥፋት ይልቅ የሚጨምረው እንዴት ነው?
questions.expected_concept: Fulfilling a desire does not free a person from desiring; it increases desire. The person who gained the money he wanted wants still more and does not say that what he gathered is enough. Any satisfaction is only temporary and does not stop further desire.

questions.question: አሠርቱ ትእዛዛት በእግዚአብሔርና በሰው መካከል ያለ ቃል ኪዳን የሚሆኑት እንዴት ነው?
questions.expected_concept: The commandments understood as a covenant.

questions.question: እግዚአብሔርን መውደድና ባልንጀራን መውደድ ከሁለቱ ጽላት ጋር ምን ግንኙነት አላቸው?
questions.expected_concept: The book divides the commandments into two parts connected with the two tablets. It says the first part contains three commandments about the worship relationship with God, and the second contains six about relations among people. The first tablet contains what concerns God, and the second teaches love of neighbor. Following Christ, church teachers call the first part love of God and the second love of neighbor.

questions.question: ሰንበት የሥጋ ዕረፍትና የነፍስ ዕረፍት ምልክት የሚሆነው እንዴት ነው?
questions.expected_concept: Physical Sabbath rest as a sign of spiritual and eternal rest.

questions.question: የሰውን ዝና ለመጠበቅ እውነትን መሥዋዕት ማድረግ ለምን እንደ ጣዖት አምልኮ ይቆጠራል?
questions.expected_concept: Preferring human reputation over truth and God.

questions.question: ራስን ማምለክ ከሌሎች ጣዖታት ሁሉ የበለጠ አደገኛ የሆነው ለምንድን ነው?
questions.expected_concept: Self-worship as the most dangerous form of idolatry.
